member.name: T:Foundgine.AI.FoundgineAiAgent
member.summary: Provider-neutral Foundgine agent facade built on Microsoft.Extensions.AI. The LLM selects tools; Foundgine remains responsible for semantic validation, authorization, planning and execution.

member.name: M:Foundgine.AI.FoundgineAiAgent.RunAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Runs one agent turn. The model may call Foundgine tools repeatedly until it has enough information to answer or the iteration limit is reached.

member.name: T:Foundgine.AI.FoundgineAiToolset
member.summary: Exposes Foundgine as a small, provider-neutral AI toolset. The model can discover the authorized semantic surface and submit provider-neutral read intent. Authentication/tenant context remains owned by the host application and is never supplied by the model.

member.name: M:Foundgine.AI.FoundgineAiToolset.CreateTools
member.summary: Creates the tools that can be supplied to any Microsoft.Extensions.AI compatible chat client or agent.
